d:
"Diwana Karke Chhodoge" is a soulful romantic duet from the 1972 Bollywood film Mere Jeevan Saathi. Composed by the legendary R.D. Burman and penned by Majrooh Sultanpuri, this track features the melodious voices of Kishore Kumar and Lata Mangeshkar. The song beautifully captures the emotions of love, longing, and the complexities of relationships.
